name: City Council
agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
June 20, 2011
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificate of Appreciation to VFW Chaplain Strecker for services to the City.
Presentation of check in lieu of city plaque by outgoing Planning Commissioner Efren Servino to Friends of Lomita Library.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: June 6 (2)
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting amendment to agreement with Civil Source Inc. to provide construction management and inspection services for citywide sidewalk and slurry seal projects in an amount not to exceed $85,050 . RECOMMEND APPROVAL
e.
Report recommending extension of Tree Services and Maintenance Agreement with West Coast Arborists. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
f.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 744, a city-initiated amendment to the Lomita Municipal Code amending Section 11-1.30.01 (Uses) to remove Senior Citizen Planned Unit Developments as a Conditionally Permitted Use in the A-1 and R-1 Zones. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
g.
Report recommending approval of agreement with Acorn Technology Corporation to install and configure various equipment and software upgrades in the amount of $89,136 and approval of a contract to perform Managed Information Technology Services for $3,675 per month. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
h.
Report recommending installation of red curb on Appian Way at 259th Place. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
i.
Report recommending award of Consultant Services Contract for Pavement Management Systems in the amount not to exceed $50,000 to Bucknam and Associates. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
FISCAL YEAR 2011/12 BUDGET Public Hearing on the proposed budget for Fiscal Year 2011/12 and adoption of resolutions adopting the budget for FY 2011/12, the annual investment policy, the annual employee compensation plan and confirming the factors used for calculating the annual appropriations limit.
Presented by Administrative Services Director Chavez.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
TIM KING MEMORIAL Discussion and possible action on the placement of a memorial to former Councilmember Tim King. Requested by Councilmember Suminaga.
8.
CONOCOPHILLIPS PIPELINE First reading of an ordinance amending Ordinance No. 726 to add the non-utility pipeline fee schedule to the existing pipeline franchise with ConocoPhillips Company.
Presented by Asst. City Manager Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
